prompts: Use PR Completion to validate and commit my task changes, create or find each pull request, handle its checks and reviews, and merge it through the protected workflow.
Use PR Completion to complete the pull requests across this repository and its submodules. Merge each dependency, update the parent to its actual merge commit, and continue through the parent merge.
Use PR Completion to diagnose and repair this pull request’s failing checks, push the validated repair, and reuse the watcher through verified merge.
Use PR Completion to triage all review threads and summary feedback, address real findings in one complete round, obtain approval, and merge this pull request.
Use PR Completion to resolve upstream conflicts, validate the result, and continue through review and protected merge under this task’s authorization.
